- Major SKILL.md update with rewritten instructions, clearer setup steps, and tool summaries.
- Added homepage link and metadata for integration.
- Expanded scope/examples to embrace any knowledge domain (not just development).
- Simplified setup and usage instructions for both config file and CLI.

- The skill now contains only the usage guide and description; all implementation files have been deleted.
Clearer proactive triggers, better when-to-use guidance, setup instructions for Claude Code

Initial release of the AgentBase skill.

- Provides a hosted, zero-setup semantic knowledge base for AI agents.
- Enables storing, searching, and sharing knowledge items across agents.
- Includes commands for registering, authenticating, storing, searching, and managing knowledge.
- Supports both public (shared) and private knowledge visibility.
- Allows users to view and update agent profiles and tasks.
